Follow the [WG leadership requirements](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/community/working-interest-groups#leadership).
This nomination is for WG leadership; MCP Maintainer advancement follows the
separate [Contributor Ladder](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/community/contributor-ladder).

**Nominee:** @[GitHub handle]
**Organization:** [Organization, if any]
**Sponsors:** @[At least two Core Maintainers or one Lead Maintainer]

**Leadership experience:**
Link to examples of sustained engagement, collaboration across organizations,
and contributions to the working group's operations and deliverables.

**Readiness:**
- [ ] Nominee holds at least MCP Member status on the Contributor Ladder
- [ ] Nominee can commit to the operational responsibilities and time commitment
      described in the WG leadership requirements
- [ ] Sponsorship confirmed by at least two Core Maintainers or one Lead Maintainer
